note: Rots et al. (2023) expanded the KDM6B cohort specifically to reduce ascertainment bias from the initial Stolerman discovery series and delineate the broad phenotypic spectrum.

evidence.text: Rots et al. assembled an expanded cohort across diagnostic testing and research cohorts specifically to reduce ascertainment bias and delineate the broader phenotypic spectrum of KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder beyond the initial Stolerman cohort.

source.title: The clinical and molecular spectrum of the KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder
